en: Waiting to be decided or settled; or about to happen.
ex: The application is still pending approval.
這份申請仍在等待批准。

en: Not stopping or becoming less strong, especially in a harsh or cruel way.
ex: The team faced relentless pressure from the media.
這支球隊面臨著來自媒體的無情壓力。

en: A condition that makes progress or success harder; or a physical or mental disability.
ex: Not speaking the language was a big handicap.
不會說這種語言是個很大的障礙。

en: Energy and enthusiasm for life; or the strength to continue to exist and grow.
ex: The old man had the vitality of someone half his age.
那位老人擁有只有他一半年紀的人才有的活力。

en: Arranged for the present time only, and likely to be changed later.
ex: The provisional results show a close race.
暫定結果顯示雙方競爭激烈。

en: Relating to the human body; or in a complete and physical way.
ex: He was charged with causing grievous bodily harm.
他被控造成嚴重人身傷害。

en: Angry because something seems unfair or insulting.
ex: She was indignant at being asked to leave.
被要求離開讓她感到憤慨。

en: Something that stops you from paying attention to what you are doing; or something that amuses you.
ex: Mobile phones are a distraction for students in class.
手機是學生上課時的干擾。

en: Lacking physical strength or power; or not effective or convincing.
ex: The old man spoke in a feeble voice.
老人用微弱的聲音說話。

en: The most exciting or important point of a story or event; or the highest point of something.
ex: The film reaches its climax in the final scene.
電影在最後一幕達到高潮。

en: To make someone decide not to do something by making them worried about the results.
ex: High prices deter many people from buying the product.
高價格使許多人不願購買這項產品。

en: To feel and show great sadness because someone has died.
ex: The whole country mourned the death of the leader.
全國都在哀悼那位領導人的逝世。

en: A strong liquid or powder used to clean clothes, dishes or other things.
ex: Use a mild detergent to wash your delicate clothes.
用溫和的洗衣精清洗你的精緻衣物。

en: To remove something from a surface by rubbing it with something sharp; or a mark made by rubbing; or a difficult situation.
ex: He scraped the mud off his shoes before coming in.
他進屋前把鞋上的泥巴刮掉。

en: Able to do many different things or having many different uses.
ex: The actor is versatile and can play comic or serious roles.
那位演員多才多藝，能演喜劇也能演嚴肅角色。

en: To make something louder or stronger; or to explain something in more detail.
ex: The speakers amplify the sound of the guitar.
喇叭放大了吉他的聲音。

en: Relating to the Middle Ages, the period in European history from about 500 to 1500 AD.
ex: We visited a medieval castle during our trip.
我們旅行時參觀了一座中世紀城堡。

en: Relevant or able to be used in a particular situation.
ex: This rule is applicable to all employees.
這條規定適用於所有員工。

en: To officially make something illegal; or (old use) a person who lives outside the law.
ex: The government outlawed smoking in public places.
政府禁止在公共場所吸菸。

en: To give money or gifts to someone in power to persuade them to do something dishonest; or the money given.
ex: He was arrested for trying to bribe a police officer.
他因企圖賄賂警察而被捕。

en: An official examination of a company's financial records; or to check accounts carefully; or to attend a class without credit.
ex: The company's accounts are audited every year.
公司的帳目每年都要審計。

en: Good knowledge of something; or a friendly or informal manner.
ex: His familiarity with the city helped us find our way.
他對這座城市的熟悉幫助我們找到路。

en: The study and treatment of mental illness.
ex: She is training to become a doctor of psychiatry.
她正在接受訓練，要成為精神科醫師。

en: Responsible for your actions and expected to explain them to others.
ex: Politicians should be accountable to the voters.
政治人物應該對選民負責。

en: A long and difficult journey, usually on foot; or to make such a journey.
ex: They trekked through the jungle for three days.
他們在叢林中跋涉了三天。

en: A person whose job is to look after a building, such as a school or apartment block.
ex: The janitor locks up the school every evening.
工友每天傍晚鎖上學校大門。

en: To mix cards by sliding them together; or to walk without lifting your feet; or to move things around.
ex: He shuffled the cards and dealt them to each player.
他洗了牌並發給每位玩家。

en: A tree with leaves that turn red and yellow in autumn; or the sweet syrup made from its sap.
ex: The maple leaf is the symbol of Canada.
楓葉是加拿大的象徵。

en: An object or custom that survives from the past; or a part of the body of a holy person.
ex: The old castle is a relic of medieval times.
那座古堡是中世紀的遺物。

en: A word that means the same or nearly the same as another word.
ex: "Big" and "large" are synonyms.
「big」和「large」是同義詞。

en: Able to read and write; or having knowledge of a particular subject.
ex: Almost everyone in the country is literate.
這個國家幾乎每個人都識字。

en: A violent, spinning column of wind that can destroy buildings.
ex: A tornado destroyed several houses in the town.
一場龍捲風摧毀了鎮上好幾間房子。

en: A person who makes or passes laws, such as a member of a parliament.
ex: The legislators voted to pass the new tax law.
立法委員投票通過了新稅法。

en: To see or show the difference between things; or to make one thing different from another.
ex: Can you differentiate between a crocodile and an alligator?
你分得出鱷魚和短吻鱷嗎？

en: Coming one after another without a break.
ex: The team won three successive championships.
這支球隊連續贏得三次冠軍。

en: Important or good enough to spend your time, money or effort on.
ex: It was a long journey, but it was worthwhile.
這是一段很長的旅程，但很值得。

en: To get rid of something that is no longer useful or wanted.
ex: Please discard the packaging after opening.
開封後請丟棄包裝。

en: To become or make something hard or firm; or to become more unfeeling or severe.
ex: The concrete will harden within a few hours.
混凝土幾個小時內就會變硬。

en: An object used to make something look more attractive; or to make something look more beautiful.
ex: The shelf was filled with small ornaments.
架子上擺滿了小擺飾。

en: To improve the quality of something by adding something to it; or to make someone richer.
ex: Traveling enriches your understanding of other cultures.
旅行豐富你對其他文化的了解。
